# The Magick Muse

> The Magick Muse (magickmuse.com) is a witchcraft education site built around The Magick Manuscript: a members' online grimoire of 20,000+ cross-linked pages across 15 grimoires (plants, crystals, oils, animals, entities and deities, astrology, timing, runes, symbols, tarot, rituals, recipes, materials, dreams and correspondences), researched from published books with sources cited.

Members also get tools built on the research: a calendar of festivals and moon phases they can add to Google, Apple or Outlook (in their own time zone, each event linked to its page), Today's Correspondences, Draw a Card (daily tarot), 300+ tarot spreads to deal digitally or at the altar, a Dream Decoder, Planetary Hours from their own sunrise and sunset, Pull a Rune (Elder Futhark or Witch's Runes), a Spell Builder, Correspondence Wheels, private notes on any page, and a 30-day beginner path.

The site is for practising witches of any path, beginners included. It is not tied to Wicca or any one tradition, and it favours sourced information over guesswork.

## The Magick Manuscript

- [The Magick Manuscript](https://magickmuse.com/grimoires): what is inside the 15 grimoires and how they link together
- [Join the Manuscript](https://magickmuse.com/manuscript/join): membership, monthly or lifetime
- [Today's Correspondences](https://magickmuse.com/manuscript/today): free daily page with the moon phase, the planet ruling the day, the Sun's sign and the season, and what suits them
- [Calendar feed](https://magickmuse.com/manuscript/calendar.ics): festivals and moon phases for Google, Apple or Outlook calendars

## Learning and shop

- [Magick Mastery](https://magickmuse.com/mastery): guides, self-paced beginner courses and the blog
- [The Market](https://magickmuse.com/market): courses (Witchcraft 101 and 111), Notion grimoire templates, and a free Crystal Grimoire template
- [The Magick Muses](https://magickmuse.com/muses): a free Discord community of 950+ practitioners
- [Our story](https://magickmuse.com/mythos): how the Manuscript began

## Blog

- [Astrology for Witches: Timing Spells by Moon & Planets](https://magickmuse.com/blog/astrology-for-witches): You don't need a birth chart to time a spell, just the seven planets, the moon's phases and signs, and a way to layer them without obsessing.
- [Candle Magick for Beginners: Colors, Anointing & Reading the Flame](https://magickmuse.com/blog/candle-magick-for-beginners): Candle magick is one of the simplest ways to start casting, so learn what candle colors mean, how to anoint a candle, how to burn it safely, and how to read the flame and wax.
- [Crystals for Beginners: How Witches Choose, Cleanse & Use Them](https://magickmuse.com/blog/crystals-for-beginners): Amethyst, citrine, clear quartz, and five more starter stones, plus how to cleanse, charge, and spot fakes before they end up on your altar.
- [Witch Tools for Beginners: What You Need & Your First Altar](https://magickmuse.com/blog/essential-witch-tools-for-beginners): Forget the Pinterest altar and start with the handful of tools a new witch uses most, plus how to set up a working altar in a whole room or a shoebox.
- [Herbalism for Witches: Working With Plants Safely](https://magickmuse.com/blog/herbalism-for-witches): From rose petals for romance to bay leaves for luck, plant magick is everywhere, and working with it safely starts with knowing your herbs.
- [Ten Years a Witch: What I'd Tell My Beginner Self](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-my-witchcraft-practice-has-changed): A lot has shifted over ten years of practice, including what I've unlearned, what I trust now, and what I'd tell my beginner self if I could.
- [How to Cast a Spell: Candles, Jars, Sachets & Sigils](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-cast-a-spell-for-beginners): Candles, jars, sachets, and sigils each do something different, so here's how to build each one and why every spell starts with a clear intention.
- [How to Celebrate Samhain: Rituals, Divination & Ancestor Work](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-celebrate-samhain): Samhain is the witch's new year, when the veil grows thin, so learn its history, when to celebrate, and simple rituals for honoring your ancestors.
- [How to Dispose of a Spell: Wax, Herbs & Spell Jars](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-dispose-of-a-spell): Once the candle burns out, the remains can be buried, burned, left at a crossroads, given to running water, or thrown away, depending on the working they came from.
- [Witchcraft Misinformation: How to Find Reliable Sources](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-find-reliable-witchcraft-information): Black tourmaline protects, or it's dangerous, or it needs a full moon first, so here's how to sort real knowledge from confident guesswork one red flag at a time.
- [How to Research Witchcraft and Find Your Own Answers](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-research-witchcraft): Every book gives a different answer, and so does every website. Research is how a witch cuts through the noise, and anyone can build the skill.
- [Ancestor Work for Beginners: Honoring Your Lineage](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-work-with-ancestors-witchcraft): Your ancestors are the closest spirits you have, and a simple altar and the right offerings can build a real relationship with them, even without a family tree.
- [Deity Work for Beginners: Approaching the Gods](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-work-with-deities-witchcraft): "Which deity is calling me?" is usually the wrong first question, so here's how to approach the gods with patience, research, and respect, and what silence can mean.
- [Working With the Greek Gods: Kharis & Offerings](https://magickmuse.com/blog/how-to-work-with-greek-gods): Kharis is the heart of Hellenic worship, a relationship built on gifts, gratitude, and showing up. Meet the Olympians and start the right way.
- [The Law of Similars: Why Like Affects Like in Magick](https://magickmuse.com/blog/law-of-similars-witchcraft): Why red for love and green for money? Meet the Law of Similars, the principle behind nearly every spell, and start reading your tools like a witch.
- [Meditation for Witches: A Beginner's Guide to Focus](https://magickmuse.com/blog/meditation-for-witches-beginners): Meditation doesn't mean an empty mind, and five minutes of breath, a little time outside, and simple grounding can change how your spellwork feels.
- [Protection Magick for Beginners: Shields, Wards & Banishing](https://magickmuse.com/blog/protection-magick-for-beginners): Before you manifest anything, protect what you have with shields, wards, banishing, and the small daily habits that make a protection practice hold.
- [Runes for Beginners: How to Read the Elder Futhark](https://magickmuse.com/blog/runes-for-beginners): Rune doesn't mean letter, it means secret, and this grounded introduction to the Elder Futhark runs from Odin's ordeal to your first three-rune spread.
- [What Is a Correspondence in Witchcraft?](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-a-correspondence-in-witchcraft): Black tourmaline for protection and Friday for love are both correspondences, the energy shared between things and the idea that holds spellwork together.
- [What Is Baneful Magick? Hexes, Curses, Bindings & Ethics](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-baneful-magick): What hexes, curses, bindings and banishing each mean, how witches think about the ethics, and what to ask before you ever work them.
- [Divination for Beginners: Tarot, Runes & Signs](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-divination-witchcraft): Tarot is one tool in a much bigger box that also holds signs, runes, pendulums, and scrying, with a simple way to find the method that fits you.
- [Shadow Work for Witches: What It Is & How to Begin](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-is-shadow-work-witchcraft): You can't know anything else until you know yourself, so learn where shadow work comes from, how it shows up in your craft, and how to start gently.
- [Your First Tarot Deck: How to Choose, Cleanse & Read](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-to-do-with-your-first-tarot-deck): You don't have to be gifted your first deck, so here's how to choose one, cleanse and bond with it, and interview it before your first real reading.
- [What to Put in a Grimoire: A Look Inside Mine](https://magickmuse.com/blog/what-to-include-in-a-grimoire): A grimoire and a Book of Shadows aren't the same thing, so take a tour of the sections inside The Magick Manuscript and decide what goes in yours.
- [Can You Be a Witch Without Being Wiccan?](https://magickmuse.com/blog/witch-without-wicca): Wicca is a religion while witchcraft is a practice, so learn the difference, where the Threefold Law comes from, and how to find your own path as a witch.
- [Best Witchcraft Books for Beginners: A Reading List](https://magickmuse.com/blog/witchcraft-books-for-beginners): Some witchcraft books are excellent and some just have nice covers, so here's a beginner reading list by topic, drawn from the shelf that built the Manuscript.
